resources.string: Check the TV\'s internet connection. Press OK on the remote to try again.
Let MFL Football show over other apps

Press OK to open the setting and turn it on for MFL Football (Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps). If this TV has no such setting, run this once from a computer on the same network:

adb shell appops set %1$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow

Then open MFL Football, press Back and pick Show scores again.
